title: Hardik Pandya shaves head, visits temple with girlfriend
summary: Cricketer Hardik Pandya has shaved his head. He visited the Venkateswara Swamy temple in Tirumala. He was accompanied by his girlfriend, Mahieka. The visit followed his decision to shave his head.
summary_points: Cricketer Hardik Pandya shaved his head.
Pandya visited the Venkateswara Swamy temple.
He was accompanied by his girlfriend, Mahieka.
The visit occurred after he shaved his head.
title_hi: हार्दिक पंड्या ने मुंडवाया सिर, प्रेमिका के साथ मंदिर में किए दर्शन
summary_hi: क्रिकेटर हार्दिक पंड्या ने अपना सिर मुंडवा लिया है। उन्होंने तिरुमाला में वेंकटेश्वर स्वामी मंदिर का दौरा किया। उनके साथ उनकी प्रेमिका माहिका भी थीं। यह दौरा सिर मुंडवाने के बाद हुआ।
